# Agent instructions

This is a timestamp converter tool written in Astro, deployed as a static site. This project uses pnpm.

## UI components
This project contains a mix of Astro and React components. For purely static components, prefer Astro components. If reactivity/interaction is required, use React.

All components should be styled using Tailwind CSS classes.

## Plan mode
When writing plans, be extremely concise. At the end of each plan, list unresolved questions. End every plan with a numbered list of concrete steps. This should be the last thing visible in the output.
